facts.fact: Countdown to 2030 and APHRC held a national workshop on 3-7 November 2025 training district-level focal points to analyse and use data from Mauritania's National Health Information System (SNIS), with practical sessions in DHIS2.

The Countdown 2030 chartbook report assesses national DHIS2 health-facility data for 2019-2024 by district and region, covering national trends, and reports that district report completeness is low against target.

note: No completeness share is stated, only that it is low; no link to other systems stated.
Lists only a national e-health strategy 2024-2030 for Mauritania; says nothing of a health management information system.
A joint team to make new Nouakchott health centres digitally ready; no national health management information system is named.

facts.fact: The health ministry says the DHIS2 platform is used nationally to collect, analyse and present health data for the SNIS.

note: The post mentions scheduled aggregate flows to DHIS2 only as a design lesson, not a system in service or a rollout.
Mentions only a planned DHIS2 export layer; no national HMIS status stated.
Carnegie tracker line lists a 2023 digital health strategy and plan, which is not a system in service or under way.
